name: Bulkcorp International Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2009, Bulkcorp International Ltd is in the business of manufacturing, distribution, selling and exports of the FIBC & other allied products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
BIL is an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14000: 2015, ISO 45000:2018, and BRC-ISSUE VI certified company by INTERTEK. It manufactures food-grade bags with an international-standard clean-room facility and a range of packaging solutions like FIBC (Jumbo Bags) and container liners, which are currently used in various industries, including fertilizer, cement, sand, food grains, sugar, cattle feed, fish meal, pulses, spices, dates, agricultural products, minerals, resin, polymers, rubber, etc.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 26.2%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 56.2 days to 140 days
